text:
Looking at this question: "revenue" is the governed term (Revenue), but the term explicitly distinguishes order-level gross revenue (orders.order_total, includes tax) from product revenue (order_item excludes tax) — and this depends on grain. "By location" only exists on the orders model (via entity:orders.location), not on order_item. So the breakdown dimension resolves the grain to orders, but "revenue" is still ambiguous between order_total (gross, includes tax) and a pretax revenue concept — however there is no pretax metric at the orders grain, only metric:orders.order_total. Since location breakdown forces the orders model, and the only revenue-shaped metric there is order_total, this is not materially ambiguous.
